description: Concrete volume, order quantity and ready-mix truck loads for a run of sidewalk, curb or curb and gutter, with an Ontario accessible path width check. Every parameter is optional and has a default. Preliminary planning only. A volume is one input to a quote; base, forming, reinforcing, joints, drainage and the municipal standard drawing also matter, and the engineer of record governs.
